name: Skull Hotel
storyline:
You just got hired by Skull Hotel as a housekeeper and today is your first day. Your task? Clean 8 hotel rooms. Sounds doable, right? But beware: deadly entities lurk in 50% of these rooms, waiting for your arrival.

With 30 unique deadly traps and hiding spots, randomly selected in each playthrough, even experienced players will need multiple attempts to survive.

Your survival depends on vigilance: scrutinize every corner, listen carefully for unusual sounds, and remain alert at all times. The "guests" of Skull Hotel always leave subtle clues to their presence - spotting these hints is your only chance to survive.
summary: A first-person horror game where you clean haunted hotel rooms while evading deadly entities. Inspect hiding spots carefully, listen for warning sounds, and spot subtle clues left by monsters. Your vigilance is your only weapon in this terrifying housekeeping shift.
